## 【全局一致性资产卡（Global Consistency Anchors）】

- **Color Palette:** warm pastel tones, 3200K studio warm lighting, consistent clay material index
- Pip: small green clay dragon.
- Toby: yellow and white clay Shiba Inu.
- Prop: one clay ball with visible finger indentations for firm grip.

### Shot 1

- **机位与构图**：中全景 / Static，Pip x=30%，Toby x=70%，prop x=50%，y=35%，sole baseline y=88%。
- **Reference Asset:** Shot 1 Start Keyframe (to be generated)
- **[T2I] 故事板关键帧生图词**：

```text
Handmade 3D clay style. Pip x=30%, Toby x=70%, prop x=50%, y=35%, sole baseline y=88%. A cozy clay playroom. Both soles rest firmly on the floor with contact shadows; both characters face inward with their hands in visible indentations on opposite sides of one clay ball. Pip has a normal torso, Toby has bent knees and a curled tail, poised at rest. The upper quarter is clear. Color Palette: warm pastel tones, 3200K studio warm lighting, consistent clay material index --ar 9:16
```

- **[I2V] 视频动态驱动词**：

```text
[Anticipation] t=0-0.75s: Pip maintains the grounded grip and elastic tension while Toby braces with bent knees and a tiny ear twitch. -> [Squash & Stretch / Exaggeration] t=0.75-2.75s: At t=0.75s Pip stabilizes the overhead ball at y=35% and keeps the existing upward effort while Toby maintains the firm grip and flat soles with a small eye response. Keep Pip x=30%, Toby x=70%, prop x=50%, sole baseline y=88%. -> [Hold & Follow-through] t=2.75-4s: Pip maintains the grounded supported grip while Toby keeps the grounded stance with tiny ear and tail motion; aftermotion decays.
```

- **Negative Prompt:** 2D, flat, realistic animal fur, text, watermark, subtitles, words, letters, deformed limbs
- **Motion Strength:** 6/10
- **Camera Mode:** Static
- **Start-Frame:** Shot 1 Start Keyframe
- **End-Frame:** Shot 1 End Frame (to be generated and extracted)
